item.title: UAE Recalls Three Supplements And Medical Product Over Safety Concerns
item.description: The Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) has ordered the withdrawal of three food supplements and one medical product from the UAE market, warning consumers against purchasing or using unauthorised items identified on online sales platforms. item.title: Sixteen Killed In Fiery Bus And Truck Crash In Southern Yemen
item.description: Sixteen people were killed on Tuesday after a heavy truck collided head-on with a passenger minibus on a road linking Al Mahfad district and the Lahmar area, east of Abyan governorate in southern Yemen, local medical reported. Eyewitnesses said the minibus burst into flames moments after the impact, leading to its complete destruction. Among the dead were a woman and her child. item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Food and Drug Authority has imposed a ban on the import of poultry and table eggs from 40 countries, alongside partial restrictions on specific regions in 16 other countries, as part of precautionary measures aimed at protecting public health and ensuring food safety in the domestic market. item.title: Every Kuwaiti Now Required To Register For National Service Within Six Months Of Turning 18
item.description: Kuwait has brought into force a new compulsory national service law requiring every male citizen to report for military service within 180 days of turning 18, in a move aimed at strengthening defence readiness and closing gaps in previous legislation. The amended law entered into effect last Sunday after its publication in the official gazette, Kuwait Al Youm. item.description: The Ministry of Hajj and Umrah has suspended three Umrah service providing companies after detecting violations involving failure to provide housing services to Umrah pilgrims in accordance with approved contractual programs. The ministry stressed that, in cooperation with relevant authorities, legal measures are being taken against the external agents contracted with these companies. item.title: Saudi Arabia: NCM Issues Orange, Yellow Alerts As Dust Storms Hit Multiple Regions
item.description: The National Center of Meteorology has issued a series of orange and yellow alerts across several regions as dust storms and active winds continue to affect large areas of the Kingdom, significantly reducing visibility. Orange alerts, indicating more severe weather conditions, were announced for parts of Makkah Region, the Eastern Province, Riyadh Region, Najran and Asir.
